_comment: ruby#421 -- the engine-compat manifest. Every release train updates the pairings as it rides; tools/check_engine_compat.py verifies the manifest against the live registries in CI (tag <-> engine_commit, crates, npm, rubygems, pypi). Runtime versions follow the engine-linked scheme {engine-semver}.{runtime-single-digit} (npm: the engine semver, the 4th segment is invalid there) -- the leptris precedent. The 1.5.23 train: parsanol-ts#103's two depth-guard fixes (the Arc'd string-span memo so the typed guard wins the native-stack race; the folded dispatch's ?-leak -- each failing terminal dispatch no longer leaks a live depth unit, so small refusing inputs refuse normally with the deepest-reporter offsets through the failure wire) + #102's byte-tier verification. release-plz semver_check=false unblocked the patch train (the additive plan-registry variants no longer compute 2.0.0). npm 1.5.24 rides the 1.5.23-engine wasm; the ruby ext lock rode to 1.5.23 BEFORE the gem bump (the freshness guard restored -- the 1.5.19-1.5.22 gems shipped on the 1.5.13 lock).
